Streaming chat completion where the assistant responds with a tool call across multiple chunks

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { Message, ToolType, createClient } from "@xberg-io/liter-llm";
async function main() {
  const client = createClient("your-api-key");
  const result = await client.chatStream({ messages: [{ role: "user", user: { content: "What is the weather in NYC?" } } as Message], model: "gpt-4", stream: true, tools: [{ function: { description: "Get the current weather for a given location", name: "get_weather", parameters: { properties: { location: { description: "The city and state, e.g. New York, NY", type: "string" } }, required: ["location"], type: "object" } }, toolType: ToolType.Function }] });
  for await (const resultChunk of result) {
    console.log(resultChunk);
  }
}

void main();
```
